$comment: The result one /code-review reviewer Agent returns for its shard under --agents N (#3167). Validated by lib/code-review-shards.js mergeShardResults(). Carries the Step 6 table fields per finding and the files the reviewer actually read. The introduced/pre-existing tag under --diff is assigned by the parent at merge, so it is deliberately not a field here.

filesReviewed.description: Paths of the shard's files this reviewer read in full. A shard file missing from this list is reported unreviewed and never marked approved.

path.description: Relative path of a file in this reviewer's shard.

category.description: correctness, security, maintainability, naming, error-handling, documentation, or a --with domain name.
